services.name: Consult

services.name: Consult
services.story: A $35 consult at a firm that set a $20 missed-consult fee. A card is saved for it, and nothing is taken. Alex pays at the front desk.

services.name: Consult
services.story: A $35 video consult. There's no front desk, so Rosie texts the bill when Ethan texts DONE.

services.name: Consult

services.name: Case review

services.name: Home will signing

services.name: Home will signing

questions_before_times: Which lawyer or firm? The customer or their AI names one. Rosie never searches or suggests.
What kind of matter: family, a will or trust, a contract, papers you were served, or something else. Only the kind, no details.
In the office, by video or by phone? For video or phone: which state will you be in?
A visit at your place: a home, a hospital or a care home?
safety_stop: someone is hurting or threatening the customer right now
license: Always: each lawyer's own license to practice, active and in good standing, in the state of the customer's matter. The firm: a registration where the state's rules require one. Each notary: their own commission.
staff_skills: ["Family law","Wills, trusts and estates","Contracts","Notary work: a notary's own commission"]
messages_never: ["what the matter is about, beyond the kind picked","the other people's names","why a conflict check didn't clear","any legal advice"]
